updates.text:
**Summary**
Multiple customers in Australia and New Zealand may have experienced slowness or errors while accessing Google Drive.
**Description**
The issue with Google Drive has been resolved for all affected customers as of Wednesday, 2026-08-19 05:40 PDT.
Our engineering teams determined the slowness was the result of a localized capacity and routing issue within our regional infrastructure.
To restore service, we implemented a fix to alleviate the network congestion and accelerated a planned infrastructure upgrade in the affected region to ensure normal performance levels.
We thank you for your patience while we worked on resolving the issue.
**Symptoms**
Affected customers in Australia and New Zealand may have experienced slowness or 502 errors, with some users briefly unable to access Drive.
**Workaround**
The issue is now mitigated

**Summary:**
Investigating access issues with Classroom’s new web homepage.
**Description:**
We are investigating reports of access issues with Classroom’s new web homepage beginning on Thursday, 2026-08-13.
Our engineering team is currently working on a potential fix while continuing to investigate the full root cause.
We will provide an update by Tuesday, 2026-08-18 13:00 PDT with current details.
We apologize to all who are affected by the disruption.
**Symptoms:**
Admins and some Teachers may experience permission errors when accessing Classroom’s new web homepage.
**Workaround:**
Users should still be able to navigate to other views from the left hand pane of the interface.

updates.text:
**Summary**
[Mitigated] Access issues for Workspace Admins with Classroom’s web homepage.
**Description**
The issue with Classroom has been resolved for all affected users as of Tuesday, 2026-08-18 15:30 PDT.
From preliminary analysis, the issue was triggered due to a recent change which caused the permission mismatch, our Engineering team has rolled out the fix to mitigate the impact.
We thank you for your patience while we worked on resolving the issue.
**Symptoms**
Workspace Admins may have experienced permission errors when accessing Classroom’s web homepage.
Remaining Classroom functionality remained unaffected.
The Classroom Mobile App and the Classroom API were unaffected by the issue.
**Workaround**
None as the issue is resolved

**Summary:**
Mitigating access issues for Workspace Admins with Classroom’s web homepage.
**Description:**
Our engineering has identified the cause and mitigation work is currently underway.
The mitigation rollout is expected to take several hours.
We will provide more information by Wednesday, 2026-08-19 8:00 PDT.
**Symptoms:**
Workspace Admins may experience permission errors when accessing Classroom’s web homepage.
Remaining Classroom functionality remains unaffected.
The Classroom Mobile App and the Classroom API are unaffected by the issue.
**Workaround:**
All other pages are unaffected and admins can navigate to other pages using the left hand pane on the interface.
Workspace Admins can still create classes without any issue.
Workspace Admins can also view the courses that they are in by going to https://classroom.google.com/h/tv

updates.text:
**Title**
[Resolved] Inbound emails from customers to Google Support were experiencing issues.
**Description**
The issue with inbound emails to Google Cloud Support has been resolved for all affected customers as of Tuesday, 2026-06-30 20:45 PDT.
From preliminary analysis, the engineering team identified a recent change which was preventing incoming emails from being processed. We have successfully rolled back the change to mitigate the impact.
Backlog processing of all the affected emails is now complete.
We thank you for your patience while we worked on resolving the issue.
**Symptoms**
Inbound emails from customers to Google Support were experiencing issues.
Case creation and updates continued to work without any issues.
**Workaround**
None as the issue is resolved.

**Title**
Inbound emails from customers to Google Support are experiencing issues.
**Description**
The mitigation rollout was completed as of 09:00 AM PDT on 30 June 2026, and all incoming emails are currently being processed without further disruption.
Our engineers are continuing to work replaying the inbound messages that were impacted between 25 June 2026 and 09:00 AM PDT on 30 June 2026. We expect the email replays to take several hours, please be advised that this backlog processing may cause case statuses to update dynamically or cause certain closed cases to temporarily reopen.
We will provide more information by Tuesday, 2026-06-30 21:30 PDT.
**Symptoms**
Inbound emails from customers to Google Support after 09:00 AM PDT on 30 June 2026 are working as expected. The affected emails from the time of the issue are being replayed.
Case creation and updates continues to work without any issues.
**Workaround**
Customers can continue to use the portal to add comments / notes.
